name: Short film trilogy with pop-up cinema tour

mentions.name: Short film trilogy with pop-up cinema tour
mentions.description: A trio of short motion pictures written, directed, produced, shot and edited by the creator, set to launch on the creator's website late next month, followed by a European tour of free screenings with a pop-up, makeshift cinema. The project is an experiment to see if the films can become fully funded by tips and donations from the audience.
